reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the Google AI embedding-request batching change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR updates the Python Google AI embedding service to batch large text collections within Gemini’s 100-input request limit while preserving result order. **Changes:** - Adds a shared batching helper for custom-client, Vertex AI, and API-key paths. - Adds a regression test verifying that 250 inputs produce batches of 100, 100, and 50 with embeddings returned in order. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​test_google_ai_text_embedding.py` | Tests batch sizes, model selection, and output order for 250 inputs. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​google_ai_text_embedding.py` | Limits embedding requests to 100 inputs and combines results across batches. |
Review effort: Balanced
